title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
takeaway: Short stories on why behaviour matters more than intelligence when it comes to money. Makes the case for patience, leaving room for error and letting compounding do the work.

title: The Intelligent Investor
author: Benjamin Graham
takeaway: The classic case for value investing: buy with a margin of safety, and treat the market as a moody partner to take advantage of rather than follow.

title: Landet som ble for rikt
author: Martin Bech Holte
takeaway: Argues that Norway's oil wealth has made the country complacent, with weak productivity growth, a growing public sector and too little private value creation.

title: Great CEOs Are Lazy
author: Jim Schleckser
takeaway: Shows how effective CEOs spend their limited time on the one constraint holding the company back, instead of simply staying busy.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
takeaway: A portrait of wealth, ambition and illusion in 1920s New York, told through Jay Gatsby's pursuit of a past he can't get back.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
takeaway: A fable about a shepherd who follows his dream across the desert — and about having the courage to pursue what you really want.
